verdict.rationale: Google ADK is a code-first framework for building and deploying agents. It does not hold a user's data or offer an end-user analytics surface, so getting built-in AI insights from 'my data inside the product' does not fit its category. Developers could build such an agent with ADK, but that is the purpose of the framework rather than a feature shipped inside it. Its built-in web UI is described only for testing, evaluating, debugging and showcasing agents, not for producing insights from data.
